title: Clump correlated results

blocks.what_we_do: Group correlated significant variants around index variants using study-cohort LD.
blocks.why: Clumping starts with the smallest p-value, assigns nearby correlated variants, and continues greedily. It describes approximately independent regions under chosen radius and LD settings. It is not fine-mapping, causal inference or proof of one causal effect per clump. Use LD from the analysed cohort rather than an unmatched external population.
blocks.you_need: The full 5.7 genotype set and unaltered PLINK association report from 6.4.
blocks.command:
```{r s7-5}
report <- guided_path(cfg, "7.5", "clump")
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "5.7"), "--clump", paste0(guided_path(cfg, "6.4", "association"), ".Disease.glm.logistic.hybrid"),
  "--clump-id-field", "ID", "--clump-p-field", "P", "--clump-p1", "5e-8", "--clump-p2", "1e-5",
  "--clump-r2", "0.1", "--clump-kb", "250", "--clump-unphased", "--out", report))
clumps <- guided_table(paste0(report, ".clumps"))
print(clumps)
stopifnot(nrow(clumps) == 3L)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s5-7_state --clump results/guided/s6-4_association.Disease.glm.logistic.hybrid --clump-id-field ID --clump-p-field P --clump-p1 5e-8 --clump-p2 1e-5 --clump-r2 0.1 --clump-kb 250 --clump-unphased --out results/guided/s7-5_clump --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--clump` reads the association report. `--clump-id-field ID` and `--clump-p-field P` name its columns. `--clump-p1 5e-8` sets index eligibility and `--clump-p2 1e-5` the secondary-report threshold. `--clump-r2 0.1` uses this correlation threshold within `--clump-kb 250` kilobases. `--clump-unphased` uses squared dosage correlation, making its LD definition explicit. `--out` names the report; threads and memory are set by the helper.
blocks.expected_result:
Three clumps describing the strong chromosome 3, 9 and 12 regions. Their index IDs and p-values are reported; this does not establish three causal variants.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks, instructor comparisons and final plot checks passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
If the LD threshold or radius changes, can the clump membership change even though the association scan is identical?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Yes. Clump membership is conditional on those settings and the LD sample.

</details>

options.explanation_markdown:
`--threads 2` limits worker threads; `--memory 2048` sets the main workspace
budget in MiB. On Windows the executable is `bin\plink2.exe`. The helper's
regression probe intentionally uses a non-English path and translates it safely.

options.name: --pfile
options.explanation_markdown: `--pfile` reads a native genotype prefix. `--missing` writes separate sample and variant missingness reports without filtering. `--out` sets the output prefix; `--threads 2` and `--memory 2048` bound resources. The R helper prints the exact command with your own safe paths.
